text:
mika: Quick check 1 first-run flow: the progress strip + sample projects push too much below the fold on narrow screens. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.dev/ux/compact-strip.png

alex: Confirmed on iPhone 12. Users see banner then must scroll for step 1. Feels like the checklist is not the primary action.

priya: a11y: dismiss icon for the banner lacks an aria-label. Also the contrast for the CTA at 14px fails AA.

jon: Suggestion: compact progress strip that shows `Step 1 of 3: Try a sample` with a small chevron to expand. Tapping opens a modal (reusing existing sheet component) with sample cards. Keeps keyboard order intact and reduces layout shift.

sam: Copy: change CTA from `Start` to `Try a sample project` and add helper `Skip for now` as a low-contrast link. Also limit visible samples to 3 with `See all` link.

alex: I'll mock two variants in Figma (strip -> modal, inline banner). Will add focus notes: set focus to dialog header, trap focus, and restore on close. Example markup suggestion included in the file.

priya: I'll add aria-labels: `Dismiss quickstart banner`, `Open sample projects list`. Use aria-live="polite" for update announcements and ensure images have descriptive alt text.

jon: I'll add feature flag `onboard_compact_strip` and telemetry events: quickstart_shown, quickstart_expanded, sample_selected, sample_created. We can A/B at 10% then 50%.

mika: Action items: Alex -> Figma variants + dev notes; Jon -> flag + telemetry; Priya -> copy + a11y updates; Sam -> review microcopy. Target incremental rollout behind flag. Closing thread.
